subject: Logic
title: Proof by Cases
description: A quick win: understand Proof by Cases.

hook.text: Can't prove it all at once? Split into cases and prove each one separately.

buildup.text: Proof by cases divides the possibilities into exhaustive groups and proves the claim for each group.

discovery.text: Prove |x| ≥ 0: Case 1, x ≥ 0, so |x| = x ≥ 0. Case 2, x < 0, so |x| = -x > 0. Both covered.

twist.text: The cases must be exhaustive—missing one leaves a gap. And they must cover everything, no overlap required.

climax.text: Case analysis is simple but effective. Complex problems often yield to careful splitting.

quiz.question: What requirement must cases satisfy in a proof by cases?
